{{Quote|There are the Zhug "brothers," of course - cast from Duros for attempting to wipe out a rival family of politically-set Duros.|translated=1|Vossk, to the Jedi Exile|<ref name="kotor2" />}}
A '''Duros family''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Dark Wars]]. These Duros were a [[Politics/Legends|politically]] connected family, unlike their rivals&mdash;a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] group known as the [[Zhug brothers]]&mdash;who were cast out from Duro after their violent, failed attempt to take out this family.<ref name="kotor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
This family was introduced in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''&mdash;a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[Obsidian Entertainment]] in [[2004]]&mdash;as a quick mention during the conversation between [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Vossk]], and the main character of the game, the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]].<ref name="kotor2" />
